scripts.deploy:build: turbo run bundle --filter=@lcase/http-server --filter=@lcase/worker-host --filter=@lcase/deploy-tasks && pnpm -F @lcase/db-prisma schema && docker compose -f deploy/remote-worker.compose.yaml build
scripts.deploy:fresh: pnpm deploy:down && pnpm deploy:build && pnpm deploy:up
scripts.test:integration: docker compose up -d --wait && S3_TEST_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 S3_TEST_BUCKET=artifacts-test S3_TEST_ACCESS_KEY_ID=minioadmin S3_TEST_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin turbo run test:integration
scripts.verify: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm bundle && pnpm deploy:build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm test:integration
